checks.rationale: Retail calls 0x004F1160 (a mode predicate), reads the selector dword at +0x108, the value at +0xD8, writes the flag at +0xE0, pushes the value into the 0x00B97B20 stack indexed by 0x00B97D24, and returns counter+1. checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate performs the same +0x108/+0xD8/+0xE0 accesses and the same array store and counter increment; the compiled object contains the array store (0x41120(,%eax,4)) and the counter store, so the side effect survives codegen unlike the HeightMap_Enter stack push.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls the predicate 0x004F1160 once and then writes the flag, one stack dword and the counter. The candidate calls the ported script-mode predicate once and performs the same three writes; there are no other calls or error branches.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail has three paths: mode true and selector nonzero -> flag 1, push, return counter+1; mode false and selector nonzero -> the same writes and return; selector zero -> flag 0 and return pThis. The candidate implements the same three paths.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither body performs floating-point arithmetic; the predicate's name mentioning float is a decompiler symbol, and the reviewed body only tests and copies dwords.
